programme.title: Mitchell Pehlke Lacrosse Show
programme.desc: Welcome to Episode 26 (Season 3) of the Mitchell Pehlke Lacrosse Show presented by Duke Cannon! In this episode, Mitch and the guys preview the PLL Playoffs and make their predictions heading into the quarterfinals. They also break down the rumor around SMU getting Division I lacrosse, and welcome Boston Cannons attackman Coulter Mackesy for an interview.

programme.title: The Scoop
programme.desc: Chris Rosenthall of Inside Lacrosse joins Joe Keegan for a two-part PLL Playoffs preview, starting with the Eastern Conference.

programme.title: Pregame Plates presented by Whirlpool
programme.desc: Jerry Ragonese, a 13-year pro lacrosse vet turned elite chef is taking his talents, and his long-time friends, into the kitchen. Cooking up epic dishes while uncovering the stories behind the meals that made the lacrosse stars of today.
